'''Talus Ironworks''' was an arms manufacturer based on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] that was known for the [[XL-2 "Flashfire" blaster pistol/Legends|XL-2 "Flashfire" blaster pistol]] and the [[ASP-9 "Vrelt" autopistol/Legends|ASP-9 "Vrelt" autopistol]]. These weapons were both manufactured during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
